reason: The story says the rough edge breaks the skin and a blood vessel, so the body needs to encounter it before the bleeding response.
expectation: The body will get a small cut that can trigger clotting.

effect: The cut is now present and the vessel has narrowed; platelets are the next likely step to stop the bleeding.
reaction: The narrowed vessel is a useful first response, though it is still bleeding.
reason: Platelets at the cut look like the most direct way to start closing the leak.
expectation: Platelets will gather at the damaged vessel and help form a plug.

effect: The platelets formed a plug that slows the leak; the remaining clotting materials may strengthen it.
reaction: It makes sense that the plug slows bleeding without necessarily finishing the job.
reason: The activated clotting factors and fibrinogen are both blood proteins associated with clotting, so I’ll try them together.
expectation: The factors will change fibrinogen into material that helps form a clot.

effect: The clotting factors turned fibrinogen into fibrin threads, which appear to form a mesh among platelets.
reaction: The thread mesh makes the next pairing clear.
reason: The fibrin threads should reinforce the platelet plug at the cut.
expectation: The threads will strengthen the plug and help stop the bleeding.

effect: The fibrin mesh reinforced the platelet plug and stopped the bleeding, although the skin is still open.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the threads and platelets work together, and useful to see that stopping bleeding is not the same as closing the skin.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding fibrin to the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the mesh reinforces the plug and stops bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was straightforward setup rather than an interesting decision, although it was needed to start the story.

surprise.text: I noticed that the vessel narrowed immediately after the cut, before the platelet plug formed.

arbitrary.text: Combining fibrinogen with clotting factors was partly a guess from their names; the purpose became clearer when the fibrin threads appeared.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the still-open skin closes, since stopping the bleeding left that part unresolved.
